name: The Ritz Carlton Charlotte
positioning: The Ritz-Carlton, Charlotte, a LEED Gold-certified hotel in Uptown Charlotte with a bi-level penthouse spa and a rooftop chef's garden
best_for: Travelers who want a spa-focused city stay in Uptown Charlotte
Guests who want to be near Charlotte Spectrum Center and Bank of America Stadium
Families interested in the Ritz Kids programme

facts.text: The hotel is a LEED Gold-certified landmark in the heart of Uptown Charlotte.
The hotel is near Charlotte Spectrum Center and Bank of America Stadium.
The spa has an Aqua Lounge, a Relaxation Lounge and Vitality Lounges.
The spa's signature treatments include pink Himalayan salt therapies.
The hotel's Bike Valet offers bicycles for complimentary guest use, first-come, first-served.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows that overlook the Charlotte skyline.
The suites have carpets inspired by a North Carolina designer.
The Veronét Vineyards Signature Experience is a vineyard escape about 30 minutes from the city, with transportation arranged.
Ritz Kids engages children to interact with the hotel's surroundings.

highlights.text: The hotel's roof holds a chef's garden grown for the hotel's kitchens, with lavender, mint and other fresh herbs and greens.
The spa is a bi-level penthouse spa with organic treatments, a salt room and an Aqua Lounge.
The Spa & Wellness Center has a bromine-treated swimming pool designed to avoid the effects of traditional harsh pool chemicals.
The hotel's dessert amenities use honey from its rooftop apiaries.
Sweet July Cafe brings together California wellness and Caribbean hospitality.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
Hotel guests may purchase access to the Spa Vitality and Relaxation Lounges for $50 per day, while the Fitness Center and Aqua Lounge are complimentary.
WhataHotel notes the urban location may have limited outdoor space.
